query:
WITH LatestSnapshot AS (
  SELECT MAX(snapshot) AS latest_snapshot
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
),
FilteredPopulation AS (
  SELECT TRIM(nationality) AS nationality,
         COUNT(DISTINCT id, dependent_seq_no) AS count
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
  WHERE snapshot = (SELECT latest_snapshot FROM LatestSnapshot)
    AND is_in_population = TRUE
    AND person_type IN ('Alien', 'Visitor')
  GROUP BY TRIM(nationality)
),
TotalNonSaudi AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total_count
  FROM FilteredPopulation
)
SELECT fp.nationality,
       fp.count,
       ROUND((CAST(fp.count AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(tn.total_count AS DOUBLE), 0)) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM FilteredPopulation fp
CROSS JOIN TotalNonSaudi tn
ORDER BY fp.count DESC
LIMIT 10
